ucs.title: [LLM] RansomHub EDRKillShifter — BYOVD loader drops vulnerable driver then nukes EDR processes
ucs.description: Hunts RansomHub's signature defense-evasion tool EDRKillShifter (tracked as 'POORTRY'-family BYOVD loader, used by RansomHub affiliates after Citrix/Fortinet initial access). The loader writes a vulnerable signed driver (RentDrv2.sys / TrueSight.sys / ZAMGuard64.sys / ZAM.sys variants) to disk, registers it as a kernel service, then issues kill calls against MsSense, MsMpEng, Sophos, SentinelAgent, CSFalconService, etc. — the chain is the actor-specific fingerprint that single-event AV signatures miss.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_path) as binary from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process IN ("*RentDrv2.sys*","*TrueSight.sys*","*ZAMGuard64.sys*","*zam64.sys*","*ZAM.sys*","*Truesight.sys*") OR (Processes.process_name="sc.exe" AND Processes.process IN ("*create*type= kernel*","*create*type=kernel*")) OR (Processes.process_name="taskkill.exe" AND Processes.process IN ("*MsSense*","*MsMpEng*","*Sophos*","*SentinelAgent*","*CSFalconService*","*CylanceSvc*","*ekrn*","*avgsvc*"))) by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.dest | rename Processes.* as * | eventstats dc(process_name) as distinctTtpCount by host user | where distinctTtpCount>=2 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 1d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let KnownVulnDrivers = dynamic(["rentdrv2.sys","truesight.sys","zamguard64.sys","zam64.sys","zam.sys","procexp152.sys","gmer64.sys"]);
let EdrProcs = dynamic(["mssense.exe","msmpeng.exe","sophosfs.exe","sentinelagent.exe","sentinelservicehost.exe","csfalconservice.exe","cylancesvc.exe","ekrn.exe","avgsvc.exe","savservice.exe","tmccsf.exe","xagt.exe"]);
let DriverDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName has_any (KnownVulnDrivers) or (FolderPath has_any (@"\Windows\Temp\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\") and FileName endswith ".sys")
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, DroppedDriver = FileName, DropPath = FolderPath,
              LoaderName = InitiatingProcessFileName, LoaderCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              LoaderSha = InitiatingProcessSHA256, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
let ServiceCreate = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where (FileName =~ "sc.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "create" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("type= kernel","type=kernel"))
         or (FileName =~ "powershell.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("New-Service","sc.exe create") and ProcessCommandLine has_any (".sys","kernel"))
    | project SvcTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, SvcCmd = ProcessCommandLine, SvcAcct = AccountName;
let EdrKills = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where (FileName =~ "taskkill.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any (EdrProcs))
         or (FileName =~ "net.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "stop" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Sense","WinDefend","SentinelAgent","CSFalconService"))
         or (FileName =~ "sc.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("stop","delete","config") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Sense","WinDefend","SentinelAgent","CSFalconService","CylanceSvc"))
    | project KillTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, KillCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
DriverDrops
| join kind=inner (ServiceCreate) on DeviceId
| where SvcTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + WindowMin)
| join kind=inner (EdrKills) on DeviceId
| where KillTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + WindowMin)
| project DropTime, DeviceName, AccountName, LoaderName, LoaderCmd, DroppedDriver, DropPath, SvcCmd, KillCmd, LoaderSha
| order by DropTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 1d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let KnownVulnDrivers = dynamic(["rentdrv2.sys","truesight.sys","zamguard64.sys","zam64.sys","zam.sys","procexp152.sys","gmer64.sys"]);
let EdrProcs = dynamic(["mssense.exe","msmpeng.exe","sentinelagent.exe","csfalconservice.exe","cylancesvc.exe","ekrn.exe","sophosfs.exe","xagt.exe"]);
let DriverDrops = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventType =~ "FileCreated"
    | where TargetFileName has_any (KnownVulnDrivers) or (TargetFilePath has_any (@"\Windows\Temp\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\") and TargetFileName endswith ".sys")
    | project DropTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, DroppedDriver = TargetFileName, DropPath = TargetFilePath,
              LoaderName = ActingProcessName, LoaderCmd = ActingProcessCommandLine, ActorUsername;
let ServiceCreate = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where (TargetProcessName has "sc.exe" and TargetProcessCommandLine has "create" and TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("type= kernel","type=kernel"))
         or (TargetProcessName has "powershell.exe" and TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("New-Service","sc.exe create") and TargetProcessCommandLine has ".sys")
    | project SvcTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, SvcCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine;
let EdrKills = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where (TargetProcessName has "taskkill.exe" and TargetProcessCommandLine has_any (EdrProcs))
         or (TargetProcessName has_any ("net.exe","sc.exe") and TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("Sense","WinDefend","SentinelAgent","CSFalconService","CylanceSvc"))
    | project KillTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, KillCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine;
DriverDrops
| join kind=inner (ServiceCreate) on DvcHostname
| where SvcTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + WindowMin)
| join kind=inner (EdrKills) on DvcHostname
| where KillTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + WindowMin)
| project DropTime, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, LoaderName, LoaderCmd, DroppedDriver, SvcCmd, KillCmd
| order by DropTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon (@EventID:1 AND (@CommandLine:(*sc*create*type=*kernel* OR *sc*create*type=\ kernel*) OR @CommandLine:(*taskkill*MsSense* OR *taskkill*MsMpEng* OR *taskkill*SentinelAgent* OR *taskkill*CSFalconService* OR *taskkill*CylanceSvc*)) OR (@EventID:11 AND @TargetFilename:(*\RentDrv2.sys OR *\rentdrv2.sys OR *\TrueSight.sys OR *\truesight.sys OR *\ZAMGuard64.sys OR *\zamguard64.sys OR *\zam64.sys OR *\ZAM.sys)))
ucs.rationale: RansomHub-specific: EDRKillShifter is the actor's own custom BYOVD loader, first attributed by Sophos in Aug 2024 and confirmed in CISA AA24-242A. Generic 'vulnerable driver' detections miss the chain — what makes this RansomHub is the loader→driver-drop→kernel-service-create→EDR-kill sequence within ~10 minutes, executed by a single SYSTEM-elevated user session right before the encryption stage.

ucs.title: [LLM] RansomHub rclone exfiltration to MEGA/Backblaze prior to encryption
ucs.description: Hunts the RansomHub affiliate exfiltration playbook documented by CISA (AA24-242A) and Symantec: rclone.exe (often renamed) is dropped to C:\ProgramData\ or C:\Windows\Temp\ with a hardcoded config and pushed to mega:/b2:/s3: remotes with high --transfers/--multi-thread-streams concurrency, immediately before the SMB-distributed ransomware payload. Pre-encryption, this is the last clean detection window.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_path) as binary_path values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("rclone.exe","svchost.exe","svc.exe","backup.exe","winupdate.exe") AND Processes.process IN ("*copy *","*sync *","*move *","*mega:*","*b2:*","*s3:*","*--config*","*--transfers*","*--multi-thread-streams*","*--no-check-certificate*")) OR (Processes.process IN ("*rclone*") AND Processes.process IN ("*mega:*","*b2:*","*--transfers*")) by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.dest | rename Processes.* as * | join type=inner host [| tstats summariesonly=t count from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest IN ("*.mega.nz","*.mega.co.nz","*.backblazeb2.com","*.b2.backblazeb2.com") by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.dest | rename All_Traffic.src as host All_Traffic.dest as exfil_dest] | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let ExfilHosts = dynamic(["mega.nz","mega.co.nz","backblazeb2.com","b2.backblazeb2.com","s3.amazonaws.com","storage.googleapis.com"]);
let RcloneArgs = dynamic(["mega:","b2:","s3:","--transfers","--multi-thread-streams","--config","--no-check-certificate","--ignore-existing","copy --","sync --","move --"]);
let Suspect = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where (FileName =~ "rclone.exe")
         or (ProcessCommandLine has_any (RcloneArgs) and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega:","b2:","s3:"))
         or (FolderPath has_any (@"\ProgramData\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\PerfLogs\") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega:","b2:","--transfers"))
    | project ProcTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ProcName = FileName, ProcPath = FolderPath, ProcCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              SHA256, ParentName = InitiatingProcessFileName, ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let Egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (ExfilHosts) or RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "rclone.exe"
         or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega:","b2:","--transfers")
    | summarize FirstEgress = min(Timestamp), LastEgress = max(Timestamp),
                ConnCount = count(), DestHosts = make_set(RemoteUrl, 10), DestIPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 10)
                by DeviceId, InitiatingProcessFileName;
Suspect
| join kind=inner Egress on DeviceId
| where FirstEgress between (ProcTime - 5m .. ProcTime + 1h)
| project ProcTime, FirstEgress, LastEgress, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ProcName, ProcPath, ProcCmd, ParentName, ParentCmd, DestHosts, DestIPs, ConnCount, SHA256
| order by ProcTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let ExfilHosts = dynamic(["mega.nz","mega.co.nz","backblazeb2.com","b2.backblazeb2.com","s3.amazonaws.com","storage.googleapis.com"]);
let RcloneArgs = dynamic(["mega:","b2:","s3:","--transfers","--multi-thread-streams","--config","--no-check-certificate","--ignore-existing"]);
let Suspect = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | where TargetProcessName has "rclone.exe"
         or (TargetProcessCommandLine has_any (RcloneArgs) and TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega:","b2:","s3:"))
    | project ProcTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
              ProcName = TargetProcessName, ProcCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine,
              ParentName = ParentProcessName;
let Egress = ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where DstHostname has_any (ExfilHosts) or Url has_any (ExfilHosts)
    | summarize FirstEgress = min(TimeGenerated), LastEgress = max(TimeGenerated),
                ConnCount = count(), Bytes = sum(NetworkBytes), DestHosts = make_set(DstHostname, 10)
                by DvcHostname;
Suspect
| join kind=inner Egress on DvcHostname
| where FirstEgress between (ProcTime - 5m .. ProcTime + 1h)
| project ProcTime, FirstEgress, LastEgress, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ProcName, ProcCmd, ParentName, DestHosts, ConnCount, Bytes
| order by ProcTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: RansomHub rclone Exfiltration to MEGA or Backblaze
id: a4f1c2e8-3d7b-4c1a-9e2f-9d4b8a7c1f2e
status: experimental
description: Detects rclone command-line invocations with cloud-storage remotes (mega:/b2:/s3:) and high-concurrency transfer flags characteristic of RansomHub affiliate exfiltration prior to encryption (CISA AA24-242A).
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-242a
tags:
  - attack.exfiltration
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.t1048.003
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_name:
    Image|endswith: '\rclone.exe'
  selection_args:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'mega:'
      - 'b2:'
      - 's3:'
      - '--transfers'
      - '--multi-thread-streams'
      - '--no-check-certificate'
  selection_renamed:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - '--config'
      - '--transfers'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'mega:'
      - 'b2:'
  filter_legit:
    Image|startswith:
      - 'C:\Program Files\rclone\'
      - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\rclone\'
  condition: (selection_name and selection_args and not filter_legit) or selection_renamed
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned backup workflows using rclone from approved install paths (allowlist by SHA256 + path).
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\rclone.exe OR *\Rclone.exe OR *\RCLONE.EXE) OR (@CommandLine:(*mega\:* OR *b2\:*) AND @CommandLine:(*--transfers* OR *--multi-thread-streams* OR *--config*))) -@Image:(C\:\\Program\ Files\\rclone\\* OR C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\rclone\\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\rclone\.exe$/i OR (CommandLine=/(mega|b2|s3):/i CommandLine=/(--transfers|--multi-thread-streams|--config|--no-check-certificate)/i))
| NOT ImageFileName=/Program Files( \(x86\))?\\rclone\\/i
| ParentBaseFileName=/(cmd|powershell|pwsh|wmic|psexec|explorer)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName], function=collect([CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName, SHA256HashData], multival=true))
| join({#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/(mega\.nz|mega\.co\.nz|backblazeb2\.com)$/i | groupBy(aid, function=count(as=exfil_dns))}, field=aid, include=[exfil_dns])
| exfil_dns>=1
ucs.rationale: RansomHub-specific: CISA AA24-242A and Symantec's Sept-2024 RansomHub teardown both name rclone-to-MEGA/Backblaze as the affiliate's preferred pre-encryption exfil method, frequently renamed and dropped to C:\ProgramData\ alongside the EDRKillShifter loader. The signal is the *combination* (cloud-remote tokens + concurrency flags + non-default path + DNS to MEGA/B2) inside a tight window before en
